design_notes.Qwen3_8B_HBM: Installed 128-PC x 6-client service RTL exists (rtl/hdc/hbm/ot_hdc_qwen_hbm_service.sv) but nothing outside tests instantiates it. GU epoch commit is Qwen-only. KV finite DAG: 198,594 nodes with 21 phase costs missing (causal_grants_r1/final_causal/summary.json).
design_notes.DeepSeek_V41_HBM: There is no shared multi-client PC service RTL for DS. The only joined scope is the directed PC10 rank0 call (1,152 calls, 9,216 shared64 children), with 0 production calls closed and 0 SRAM ACK observations. The GU epoch protocol is not inherited (atomic_source_g0.py:94). Every RTL-present cell for matrix/KV/L2/KV_write is ABSENT for DS until the same gate is instantiated.

zero_cost_flags.what: Write completion has no ready; counter decremented on any wr_done for the client (zero-cost always-capture sink, no tag check)
Read credit (credit_we=0) granted with no identity match
Bulk-copy response has no ready and no tag validation
RF_both_copy_write count fixed at 0 (assumed charged in PC5/PC9 producer intervals; reuse unverified)
cost_addition=0, C0_V1_I64_provider_RF_mirror_cost_added=0, additional_cost=0: grant ledger adds no time; mirror writes priced only if existing intervals already contain them
structural_frontier nodes (Qwen.PC*.retire, fence :ready) take 0 duration; native PC retire carries no reverse/CDC cost
incremental_I64_RMW_charge=0, extra_C0_V1_I64_provider_charge=0; merge priced at 1 edge with SS_FF_merge_verified=False
stall_bound=1 per L2/shared word with no source

defects.what: Default-off branch assigns undeclared 'commit_ready' (implicit net); output commit_r is UNDRIVEN when ENABLE=0. Verilator: IMPLICIT + UNDRIVEN. Violates default-off cleanliness.
C0/V1 model consumes two independently timed mirror ACKs; RTL produces one combined ACK. Use the h1_combined_ACK form (production_owner.py:136) or the KF combined_ACK form.

work_items.title: Default-off hygiene: drive commit_r=0 in the r14 provider off-branch
work_items.change: Successor file (original is pinned by installed_r2 sha a8516d20) with assign commit_r=0. No behaviour change when ENABLE=1.
closes: hygiene prerequisite for every later item

work_items.title: Exact completion capture in the comparator PC service
work_items.change: ot_hdc_qwen_pc_service successor with param EXACT_COMPLETION=0: a per-client 16-entry outstanding table {tag32,gen,we}; read return and wr_done must match a live entry of the right direction, else sticky fault; add p_wr_done_rdy (or a 1-entry held capture register per client with backend stall) and c_wr_done_rdy; fault gates grant.
gates: tests/test_h3_complete_native_calendar_installed_r2.py (add an InstalledQwenPC successor that mirrors the new RTL)

work_items.title: Generation on r14 credits and read-credit match
work_items.change: Provider successor: carry a generation field in wr_word/credit; read credit (credit_we=0) must match a live mapped read owner; KV adapter compares the full MTAGW tag plus generation.

work_items.title: Identity-bearing common RF ACK
work_items.change: rf_service successor (param ACK_ID=0) registers {owner_tag,generation} at write_go and returns it with ack_valid. Update the C0/V1 model to consume one combined ACK, not two timed mirror ACKs.

work_items.title: Installed owner gate replacing external grant bits
work_items.change: New ot_gpu_hbm_owner_gate (ENABLE=0): one finite lease entry per SM plus one per shared/L2 bank {gen64,seq40,rank,SM,lease,provider_ref}, contenders C0/SIMD/matrix-result/KV/L2. It drives rf_owner_grant/shared_owner_grant and holds the lease through consumer and reverse; the rotating cursor advances only on reverse (the BankArbiter policy). Size it from the 324-bit entry and 12,288-context envelope in installed_services_r2/model.json, narrowed by the emitted DAG.

work_items.title: Visibility -> consumer -> reverse ports on the RF fence
work_items.change: Fence successor: add consumer_accept and reverse_grant handshakes after fence_valid, widen the 8-bit epoch to an owner-gate tag, and instantiate it behind the owner gate (still ENABLE=0).
closes: visibility/consumption/reverse_retirement for C0, SIMD and matrix results

work_items.title: Endpoint trace export into CausalGrantLedger
work_items.change: The bench emits per-bank acceptance, capture, common ACK, child reverse, fence, consumer and reverse events as origin=endpoint_trace for one PC0 RMW parent and one PC10 shared64 parent; replay them through CausalGrantLedger.observe.

work_items.title: KV write sector owner in RTL
work_items.change: SectorTransaction in RTL behind the owner gate: old-sector capture with a full-sector validity receipt, mask merge, write with W2 exact completion, then consumer and reverse. Add a MetadataFence that orders bitmap before record under writer exclusion. Reuse the KV adapter single-outstanding pattern.

work_items.title: Generic L2 word endpoint plus bank fence
work_items.change: RTL of BankFence/AtomicConnector: L2_128 read/write with a 16-bit seat tag tied to a full generation in the owner gate, visible, consumer and reverse; GU commit joins the same fence.

work_items.title: CDC on HBM-service <-> SM boundaries
work_items.change: Instantiate the r14 fifo2/clock_bridge on the request, return, write-completion and reverse paths of the comparator, exporting both-domain edge ordinals; lift the H1-only refusal in CausalGrantLedger only for paired receipts.

work_items.title: Bounded backend and credit-return terms (elapsed wait)
work_items.change: From the W2/W10 benches, take a source-pinned backend acceptance gap and credit-return upper bound with a directed worst-case stimulus. Feed them to InstalledQwenPC.fairness and finite_bounds. Replace stalls=0 defaults and stall_bound=1 with these bound terms.
closes: elapsed_wait_bound for all classes (conditional until SS/FF in context)

work_items.title: Starvation freedom under the emitted DAG
work_items.change: For the r14 allocation priority (tag_owner.sv:27) and write-visibility priority (provider.sv:86-91), either add a default-off bounded-aging counter or prove finite contender exhaustion from the emitted lease/contender DAG (the Qwen KV finite DAG). Replace the priority with round-robin for any contender pair that cannot be proven.

work_items.title: Reconcile zero-cost placeholders
work_items.change: For each zero_cost_flags entry, either attach the existing interval id that already charges it (with receipt) or price it positively; structural_frontier retire gets the native reverse/CDC term.

headline: No HBM-comparator RTL composes owner identity, common ACK, visibility, consumer, reverse and CDC together. The r14 composition does it only in tb_hbm_finite_stage (ROM persistent-KV vehicle), and the installed comparator PC service is count-only with no write-completion ready.
